modification_reason: Add Conflicts: openssl-libs < 1:4.0 to openssl3-libs to prevent the shared libcrypto.so.3/libssl.so.3 file conflict with base openssl while base is < 4. Also added gorget source-pipeline.yaml (HUM-6081; pattern from HUM-4622): Source0 was a bare filename with no URL, resolved only by Fedora's own lookaside metadata -- repointed the fetch at the real GitHub release asset (github.com/openssl/openssl/releases/download/openssl-${VERSION}/), which matches the existing recorded checksum exactly, no content change.
